t: 在蒙塞古尔陷落后,200多名拒绝退位的卡特人被烧死.
te: Over 200 Cathars who refuse to recant are burnt to death after the Fall of Montségur.
dz: 在蒙塞古尔陷落后,200多名拒绝退位的卡特人被烧死.
de: Over 200 Cathars who refuse to recant are burnt to death after the Fall of Montségur.

t: 阿拉贡王冠和卡斯蒂利亚王冠在"阿尔米兹拉条约"中就各自向al-Andalus扩张的限度达成一致.
te: The crown of Aragon and the crown of Castile agree in the Treaty of Almizra on the limits of their respective expansion…
dz: 阿拉贡王冠和卡斯蒂利亚王冠在"阿尔米兹拉条约"中就各自向al-Andalus扩张的限度达成一致.
de: The crown of Aragon and the crown of Castile agree in the Treaty of Almizra on the limits of their respective expansion into al-Andalus.

t: 这座城市向克瓦拉兹米耶亚投降,结束了基督教对耶路撒冷接下来672年的控制.
te: The city surrenders to the Khwarazmiyya, ending Christian control of Jerusalem for the next 672 years.
dz: 围攻耶路撒冷:这座城市向克瓦拉兹米耶亚投降,结束了基督教对耶路撒冷接下来672年的控制.
de: Siege of Jerusalem: The city surrenders to the Khwarazmiyya, ending Christian control of Jerusalem for the next 672 years.

t: 教皇英诺森四世抵达里昂参加里昂第一次大公会议。
te: Pope Innocent IV arrives at Lyon for the First Council of Lyon.
dz: 教皇英诺森四世抵达里昂参加里昂第一次大公会议。
de: Pope Innocent IV arrives at Lyon for the First Council of Lyon.
